To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday’s admin meeting

Renee — here’s my football rundown for Monday. We had plenty of good news this week.

Friday’s game: We beat Brookhollow 31–14. The kids voted Deshawn Pettaway defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches had even met, and he earned it with three sacks and seven tackles. Tavion Hurst finished with 188 rushing yards and two touchdowns. His long touchdown in the third quarter came behind the best blocking I’ve seen from our line all year — they were pushing their guys five yards back on that drive. Our defense also held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half. The win locked up second place in the region.

Playoffs: We have a HOME playoff game against Clanton Valley this Friday, Nov. 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows we’re hosting, and let’s encourage folks to come out. I’d love to see a big crowd for these kids. Ticket presale starts Tuesday, and we need the gate and chain crews confirmed by Wednesday. The boosters are also looking for six more concession workers for the game.

Academics: The nine-week grade check is clean. All 52 players are eligible, with nobody on the list. Tonya Greer’s Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason for that, and she deserves the credit, not me. She’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

Booster club: The final Boston butt sale count was 208 sold and $6,240 raised, well past the $4,500 goal. That money is going toward the new sideline headsets. Huge thanks to Carla’s crew and to Hargrove’s Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost.

And I haven’t forgotten the bus situation. If we win and go on the road, I’ll get the bus information to you. I know transportation needs playoff away-game requests five days out.
